youtube_description:
LASD Commander Todd Rogers is invited back to speak live on 106.7 KROQ-FM "Open Line" about the Los Angeles Regional Crime Stoppers Program.

Commander Todd S. Rogers is a 28 year veteran of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. He is assigned to Field Operations Region II where he oversees the Avalon, Carson, Compton, Century, and South Los Angeles Stations in addition to the countywide Community Oriented Policing and Operation Safe Streets Bureaus. 

Commander Todd S. Rogers leads two nonprofit organizations that raise money to support local schools, teachers and students. He was elected to the Lakewood City Council in 2001 and has since been re-elected in 2005 and 2009. He served his second term as mayor during 2009-10. He holds both a Bachelor of Arts in History and a Master of Arts Degree in Sociology from California State University, Dominguez Hills.
